001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.opentelemetry;
002
003import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogConfig;
004import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEventFactory.KeyValuesContributor;
005import io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi.RainbowGumServiceProvider;
006import io.jstach.svc.ServiceProvider;
007
008/**
009 * Registers the current OpenTelemetry span's ids as the
010 * {@link KeyValuesContributor.Source.Standard#OPENTELEMETRY} key values source. Simply
011 * having this module on the classpath is enough; disable it with
012 * <code>logging.keyvalues.disabled=opentelemetry</code>.
013 */
014@ServiceProvider(RainbowGumServiceProvider.class)
015public final class OpenTelemetryConfigurator implements RainbowGumServiceProvider.Configurator {
016
017        /**
018         * Key value holding the current span's trace id.
019         */
020        public static final String TRACE_ID_KEY = "traceId";
021
022        /**
023         * Key value holding the current span's span id.
024         */
025        public static final String SPAN_ID_KEY = "spanId";
026
027        /**
028         * For service loader.
029         */
030        public OpenTelemetryConfigurator() {
031        }
032
033        @Override
034        public boolean configure(@SuppressWarnings("exports") LogConfig config, @SuppressWarnings("exports") Pass pass) {
035                KeyValuesContributor.register(config.serviceRegistry(), KeyValuesContributor.Source.Standard.OPENTELEMETRY,
036                                OpenTelemetryContributor.INSTANCE);
037                return true;
038        }
039
040}
